reviewer: Independent statistical review by recover_rust_work subagent

execution_method.prior_read: Read exact GitHub result blob e2621c07bc3841e5f427210cf1b8531d0f416ae9 and formal job log 133965795078; first independently checked arithmetic in JavaScript.
execution_method.this_execution: Re-read local analysis.json, run.json and manifest.json; independently recompute in this standard-library-only Python script; import no product or experiment analyzer code.
execution_method.round_arithmetic: 100 * (1 - candidate_ms / baseline_ms); arithmetic mean across whole paired rounds; check per-round values and direction counts.
execution_method.registered_gates: Re-evaluate >=5 percent mean, positive reported 95 percent CI, >=5/6 positive rounds; regressions require mean<-3 percent, reported CI upper<0 and >=5/6 negative rounds.
execution_method.bootstrap_sensitivity: Enumerate every with-replacement whole-round bootstrap sample (6^6=46656 per main comparison; 3^3=27 per A/A comparison); compute exact percentile 95 percent intervals. This post-result sensitivity analysis does not replace the frozen 10000-resample Monte Carlo analysis or redefine acceptance.
execution_method.source_hash_scope: Check recorded manifest before/after equality only; do not claim to have reopened original runner binaries.

conclusion.recommendation_zh: 保留当前 Python+C 架构；本轮结果不构成全面 Rust 重构的必要性证据。Unicode 查表是有证据的局部优化方向；相同策略 C 对照也达到门槛，99条 Rust/C 控制比较没有5%的实质收益。
conclusion.production_authorization: This review recommends a decision only and changes no production code, main, release tag or public README.

limitations: The statistical reviewer re-read summary pair/resource records, not all 186 raw worker reports or 1252200 ledger events; the root agent performs the separate complete offline analyzer replay.
Original host source/binary byte verification (209 files) is a published runner result. This reviewer checked recorded before/after hashes, not the original host binaries.
Exhaustive bootstrap sensitivity is post-result and must not be substituted for the registered Monte Carlo results; per-scenario intervals have no multiplicity adjustment.
Only six paired main rounds and three A/A rounds on one Linux x86-64 runner; ingestion A/A fresh-ingestion CI is wide even though its gate is not triggered.
synthetic61 denotes seed 61 and contains 168 queries; public1015 has 1015 queries; Unicode stress has 96 queries. Query count is not the independent statistical sample size.
Rust candidates retain CPython FFI, the GIL, Python SQLite and significant Python objects. A standalone Rust service, concurrency redesign and a complete Rust-owned retrieval pipeline are unmeasured.
Resource means here are descriptive across 18 worker/cohort pairs. Sampled RSS and different process high-water marks must not be summed as a simultaneous process-tree peak.
Experimental adapter activation cost is not an inherent property of the implementation language.
